purpose: prospective confirmation of the flag-stratified union-intersection audit engine (SRAC-UI) developed post hoc on blocks 8 and 11-14 (results_stratified_ui_audit_v1): does it beat the frozen SRAC engine and the uniform betting comparison RLA at equal label budget on fresh victims?
development_disclosure: SRAC-UI and its flagged share (0.1, the best of 0.5/0.25/0.1 in the post-hoc analysis) were chosen on blocks 8 and 11-14. Seeds 201-254 are disclosed and excluded; seeds 255-264 have never been trained. Victim, attack, detector, family, and policy are those of block 8 unchanged.
dataset: GTSRB official 43-class split and frozen 32x32 cache
population: all clean training members plus every added poison copy
detector: pinned upstream BackdoorBench SCAn feature primitive
trusted_reference: deterministic half of official test records in every class

protected_groups.name: regulatory_and_priority
protected_groups.meaning: speed, priority, access, and end-of-restriction controls

protected_groups.name: speed_control
protected_groups.meaning: speed limits and end of speed/passing restrictions

protected_groups.name: priority_control
protected_groups.meaning: right-of-way, priority road, yield, and stop

protected_groups.name: road_surface_or_work
protected_groups.meaning: bumpy, slippery, work-zone, and ice/snow conditions

certificate.security_object: global poison recall at least 0.8 and clean flag rate at most 0.1 in every predeclared semantic protected set

srac_ui.alpha_per_assertion_direction: delta/(2A), A = 1 + number of groups with a flagged record

comparators.srac: frozen core, share 0.5, exact two-sided intervals, eta = delta/(2Q)

draw_namespace: gtsrb-srac-ui-confirm-v1|<victim_id> with engine label; independent draws per engine

analysis.V: zero false GO and zero false NO-GO for srac_ui
analysis.P1: victim-level mean GO difference srac_ui - srac on policy-passing victims at k=2000; supported iff the 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0
analysis.P2: same contrast srac_ui - rla_bet at k=2000
analysis.secondary: contrasts at k=8000, 16000; NO-GO on failing victims; rla_bet labels used
analysis.if_no_passing_victim: P1 and P2 are not evaluable and are reported as such

stopping_rule: train and score all ten seeds once; no engine, share, alpha, family, or endpoint change after any block-16 output
limitations: Hash-bound locally without a third-party timestamp.
Confirms the engine on one dataset, model, attack, and detector (GTSRB/TinyCNN/global blend/SCAn).
